senses.gloss: f. (denom. of אוּר, cmp. Syr. אירא P. Sm. 167) boiler, kettle.
units: <cite ref="Chullin 108a:12">Ḥull. 108ᵃ</cite> <he>י׳ של חלב</he> a kettle of milk.
Ab. Zar. 76ᵃ י׳ קטנה בתוך י׳ גדולה put a small boiler into a large one filled with water, v. גָּעַל; a. fr.—Esp. the dyer’s kettle, dye.

<cite ref="Bava Kamma 99a:1">B. Kam. 99ᵃ</cite> top <he>הקדיחו י׳</he> (Ms. H. <he>הקדיחתו</he>) the dye burnt it (the wool); <cite ref="Mishnah Bava Kamma 9:4">ib. IX, 4</cite> (<cite ref="Bava Kamma 100b:2">100ᵇ</cite>) <he>הקדיחתו י׳</he> (v. Rabb. D. S. a. l. note 30); Y. ib. IX, 6ᵈ bot. <he>הקדיחה י׳</he>.—

<cite ref="Chagigah 15b:15">Ḥag. 15ᵇ</cite> (in Chald. dict.) <he>כל עמר דנחית לי׳ סליק</he> does the wool that goes into the kettle always come out sound?, i.e. does every student of mystic philosophy escape death or scepticism?—
Sabb. I, 6; a. e.—Pl. יוֹרוֹת; י׳ הערביים improvised fire places of the Arabs, a cavity in the ground laid out with clay.
